title: Aqualung
description: The recipe combines glass, a nautilus shell and a turtle scute to create a useful diving item for long underwater trips.
body:
# Aqualung

> Stay underwater much longer in Minecraft survival.

**Aqualung** adds a simple underwater breathing item for Minecraft.

The Aqualung is worn in the head armor slot and greatly extends the time you can stay underwater.

**It gives an OXYGEN_BONUS of +49, which means air is consumed about 50 times slower than normal.**

This makes underwater exploration, building and cave diving much easier, while still keeping the survival feeling of vanilla Minecraft.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/LQvp6G4yGA0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features

| Feature          | Description                                                            |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Aqualung         | New wearable head slot item                                            |
| Oxygen bonus     | Gives `OXYGEN_BONUS +49`                                               |
| Air usage        | About `50x` slower air consumption underwater                          |
| Survival balance | Makes underwater gameplay easier without removing the survival feeling |
| Crafting         | Includes crafting recipe                                               |
| Loot             | Includes loot table                                                    |
| Resources        | Includes item resources                                                |

## Best For

* Ocean exploration
* Underwater bases
* Shipwrecks and ruins
* Coral reef builds
* Flooded caves
* Long underwater mining sessions
* Survival worlds where water should still feel dangerous

## Crafting Recipe

### Aqualung

```text
GGG
GNG
.T.
```

| Symbol | Item           |
| ------ | -------------- |
| `G`    | Glass          |
| `N`    | Nautilus Shell |
| `T`    | Turtle Scute   |

## Glass Cased Torch

Aqualung also adds a **Glass Cased Torch** for underwater builds.

### Glass Cased Torch Features

| Feature       | Description                                                                               |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Block ID      | `glass_cased_torch`                                                                       |
| Design        | Torch inside a glass casing                                                               |
| Water support | Supports waterlogged state                                                                |
| Placement     | Works underwater                                                                          |
| Light level   | Emits light level `14`                                                                    |
| Use case      | Great for underwater bases, ocean paths, docks and flooded caves                          |
| Assets        | Model, blockstate, item, lang, loot table and recipe added under the `aqualung` namespace |

## Glass Cased Torch Recipe

```text
GGG
GTG
GGG
```

| Symbol | Item  |
| ------ | ----- |
| `G`    | Glass |
| `T`    | Torch |

## Why Use Aqualung?

Vanilla underwater gameplay can be frustrating when you want to explore, mine or build for more than a few seconds.

Aqualung gives you more time underwater without removing the survival challenge.

You still need to care about air.

You just get enough time to actually do something useful below the surface.
